questions.question: At which ground did Rhinos record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 46, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/02/03.

questions.question: Which team has finished runner-up more times than any other in this database (7), despite winning the title only twice in that span?
questions.explanation: Lions finished runner-up 7 times across List A and T20 Division 1 between 2012/13 and 2025/26, but won the title only twice.

questions.question: Tazmin Brits set a database record (22/23 season, List A) with a value of 478. Which record is it?
options: Best Bowling Figures in an Innings
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Runs', held by Tazmin Brits.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Lions or Dragons?
At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
At which ground did Selaelo Mphahele record their career-best innings (26, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/06.
